## Modules

- [Membrane.RTCP](https://membrane-rtp-format.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTCP.md): Description of RTCP stream.

- [Membrane.RTP](https://membrane-rtp-format.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.md): This module provides caps struct for RTP packet.

- [Membrane.RTP.PayloadFormat](https://membrane-rtp-format.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RTP.PayloadFormat.md): This module contains utilities for resolving RTP default payload types,
encoding names, clock rates and (de)payloaders.

- [Membrane.SRTP.KeyingMaterialEvent](https://membrane-rtp-format.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.SRTP.KeyingMaterialEvent.md): Event containing keying material for SRTP encryptor and decryptor.
